name: @egen/esm-theme
description: Dynamic, schema-agnostic theme engine with priority-based JSON loading, light/dark resolution and per-app scoped overrides for EGEN SPA

scripts.build: rimraf dist && concurrently "swc --strip-leading-paths src -d dist" "tsc --project tsconfig.build.json"
